label: C2 is its weak form plus the difference (inference)
rule: Forward by projection; backward, the difference closes the cause disjunct of the weak form
meaning: Certified difference (#1598) of the registration C2 strengthens C2-minus, with no background: C2 holds iff C2-minus holds and every contingent being with a distinct esse-cause is existentially receptive or has a simply prior one. Premise-free and constructive; it asserts none of the statements compared.
